status: Collaboration handbook now has an owner-local native HTTP router and the Next handbook transport is cut over fail-closed; native Messaging direct/group threads and native Social posts/comments/mentions/moderation/reactions/follows/topics/feed are PostgreSQL-qualified. Composition mounting, SSR cutover, attachments, teams/channels and browser acceptance remain open.

http.transportFacts: Exact host+holding target, exact browser origin on POST, one bounded Idempotency-Key matching the existing service-command contract, 192000-byte body bound, 1..100 page bound, opaque cursor decode/re-encode, stable 403/404/409/422/503 error mapping, private no-store response headers.
http.authorityBoundary: The router never resolves a session or mints Company/editor/purchase authority. A composition-owned HandbookHttpBackend resolves the normal Account session, current Holding/Company scope, membership, editor/owner authority and purchase; executes CAS/replay on one serializable owner unit.
http.frontend: packages/feature-collaboration/src/adapters/server/native-handbook.ts plus packages/feature-apps/src/routes/api/v1/holdings/[holdingSlug]/handbook/[[...path]]/route.ts. The Next route calls only native HTTP and returns 503 NATIVE_HANDBOOK_UNAVAILABLE when ERPX_NATIVE_HANDBOOK_CONFIG is absent; no TS service fallback remains in the route.

workflows: Threads: publish a Company or branch-scoped post and reload bounded authorized history
Mentions: resolve current Company-readable person/record labels through owner ports, dedupe, persist social_mentions and person staff_notifications
Comments & moderation: reply, author edit, author/reviewer tombstone with optimistic version CAS
Following & reactions: idempotent appreciation and post/topic follows
Topics & feed: normalized hashtags/tags, bounded all/following/team/records feed and comment readback
social.authorityBoundary: The owner module selects only social_posts/social_comments/social_reactions/social_follows/social_topics/social_post_topics/social_comment_topics/social_mentions/staff_notifications. Person and record mention targets are resolved by a composition port; no People, IAM, Organization or Records SQL is embedded in Collaboration.

scope.preserved: Existing handbook lifecycle, collaboration action-card/record-relation slice, maintenance/service-count notifications, Field inbox/outbox and push contracts are unchanged.

workflows: Threads: create a direct conversation from a stable composition-supplied participant key or a group room with a normalized name and current Company participants
Messages: send bounded text, append a monotonic sequence under the owner update guard, reload authorized history with before/after cursors
Reads: upsert monotonic per-member read state and compute unread counts; direct/group membership is rechecked before every command and read
messaging.authorityBoundary: The owner module selects only messaging_rooms/messaging_room_members/messaging_messages/messaging_reads. Current Company membership and the stable direct-conversation key are supplied by composition; no IAM/People SQL is embedded in Collaboration.

tests.environment: ERPX_TEST_ADMIN_URL from ignored .env.local; local PostgreSQL 18.6 on 127.0.0.1:5432; isolated erpx_dev_rust_* test databases

breakdown.lib: 26 passed (7 handbook HTTP transport/handler, 7 social domain/adapter, 4 messaging domain, 8 handbook domain/wire)

tests.newCoverage: 8 native-handbook transport/route-guard tests; 21 existing handbook service tests

behaviouralCoverage.authorization: Membership denial, editor/owner denial, moderator denial, author-only comment edit, non-editor draft denial through the existing handbook slice; Social authority is supplied by the composition port and denied before owner effects in unit and PostgreSQL tests.
behaviouralCoverage.companyIsolation: Handbook reads/writes and Social feeds select current Company rows only; an other-Company actor sees no post or article and cannot replay across Company scope.
behaviouralCoverage.casVersion: Handbook article/editor versions and Social comment versions reject stale expectations without writing receipts or effects.
behaviouralCoverage.idempotency: Exact replay returns the retained receipt without a second owner write; same-key different operation/actor/record/fingerprint returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT in the PostgreSQL harness.
behaviouralCoverage.moderation: Author edit/tombstone and reviewer tombstone are separately asserted; a reviewer cannot edit another author's comment.
behaviouralCoverage.persistedEffects: Post/comment/topic/mention/reaction/follow rows, staff notifications, command receipts, audit and outbox counts are asserted after commit and re-read in a fresh transaction.
behaviouralCoverage.rollback: A tampered retained effect or revoked authority rolls back the post/comment/receipt/audit/outbox unit; Social PG test proves counts are unchanged after the failed unit.
behaviouralCoverage.negativeCases: Company audience without current role, branch audience without branch, unreadable person mention, unreadable record, invalid hashtag, invalid cursor, oversized body, missing/wrong origin, missing/invalid idempotency key, stale version and replayed tombstone.
behaviouralCoverage.threadsMessages: Direct and group rooms normalize participants, reuse the composition-supplied direct key, enforce current Company membership and room membership, append monotonic message sequences with an owner update guard, persist read state and reload bounded before/after history. Replay returns the retained receipt without a duplicate message.

compositionMountDelta.summary: Main must implement HandbookHttpBackend in src/composition and merge the owner router. Do not change the owner crate API for this mount.
compositionMountDelta.cargo: src/composition/Cargo.toml already depends on erpx-server-collaboration through workspace use; no new dependency edge is required.
compositionMountDelta.routerImport: use erpx_server_collaboration::public::handbook_http::{HandbookHttpBackend, HandbookHttpCommandRequest, HandbookHttpReadReply, HandbookHttpReadRequest, HandbookHttpTarget, HandbookDetailData, HandbookListData, HandbookEditorsData, handbook_router};
compositionMountDelta.targets: Build one HandbookHttpTarget per registered Holding host/slug with the exact AccountPolicy origin and an Arc<HandbookHttpBackend>. Reject duplicate (host, slug) pairs.
compositionMountDelta.backend: Resolve normal Account session/cookies, Host/Holding, Company, branch/department and rendered context from headers; check membership/module/purchase/editor/owner; open TransactionOptions serializable; acquire lock_handbook_sources before IAM/purchase snapshots; for commands implement HandbookUnit (authorize, replay, article, settings_version, is_company_member, apply via apply_plan+retain_effects, flush_deferred, require_unit_current) and use execute(key, change); for reads call read_list/read_article_detail/read_editor_options and construct HandbookListData/HandbookDetailData/HandbookEditorsData with current access facts.
compositionMountDelta.mount: Merge handbook_router(targets)? into the composition router used by foundation_router_with_inventory. Do not mount it in the TS compatibility route.
compositionMountDelta.tsConfig: Set ERPX_NATIVE_HANDBOOK_CONFIG to JSON {privateBaseUrl, timeoutMs, holdings:[{origin,holdingSlug,holdingId}]} pointing at the composition-owned native service. The client rejects reserved ports 3000/3001/3100/3101(dev)/3103/5432/5433/5435/8080, ports 3200-3299, non-loopback hosts and duplicate origins/slugs.
compositionMountDelta.ssr: To finish SSR cutover, replace handbookList/handbookArticle/handbookEditorOptions in packages/server-collaboration/src/adapters/presentation-queries.ts with a composition adapter backed by the same native reads, then verify the pages under packages/workplace/src/routes/holdings/[holdingSlug]/knowledge/handbook/* and learn.

browserJourneysMainMustRun: Sign in normally at the registered Holding host (for example https://acme.jesadakorn.com) and open Knowledge -> Handbook published and drafts. Confirm published articles load from the native read path and draft controls appear only for an appointed editor.

As an editor create a draft, edit it, publish, archive and restore it; reload and verify the persisted version/revision, revision history, list membership and archive visibility. Replay the same Idempotency-Key and confirm no duplicate revision.

As a plain member confirm the draft list and edit actions are denied; as a non-owner confirm editor management is denied; as the service owner appoint/remove an editor and verify the settings version changes.
Use a second registered Holding/Company (for example https://northstar.jesadakorn.com) and confirm the first Company's handbook is not visible and direct article IDs return 404.
Unset ERPX_NATIVE_HANDBOOK_CONFIG and confirm handbook GET/POST returns 503 NATIVE_HANDBOOK_UNAVAILABLE without writing; restore config and confirm the same journey works.

If Social UI is mounted later: publish a branch post with a person/record mention and hashtag, reply/edit/tombstone the comment, appreciate/follow/unfollow, switch all/following/records filters and reload; verify another branch and another Company cannot read the branch post.

If Messaging UI is mounted later: start a direct thread with a current Company participant, send/reply, reload history, mark read and confirm unread clears; create a group thread, switch users, and confirm a non-participant and another Company cannot read or post.
